blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Sibol swept Kazakhstan, 2-0, to complete a perfect group-stage campaign and advance to the quarterfinals of the Mobile Legends: Bang Bang event at the Asian Games 2026 esports competition on Tuesday. After a 14-minute win in the opening game, the Philippine esports national team put Kazakhstan away in even more emphatic fashion in Game 2, winning 20-4 in 11 minutes.
